situations.headline: Phoslock (PET) advances patent-pending high-lanthanum phosphorus-binder family toward field trials

changelog.entry: stage-2 assessment: Phoslock (PET) advances patent-pending high-lanthanum phosphorus-binder family toward field trials (interest 7, risk 6)

thesis.text: PET's core Phoslock business could see a step-change if its new patent-pending 10-25% lanthanum product family clears field trials and scales on existing manufacturing infrastructure, potentially enabling much lower dosage, better margins, and premium pricing versus its legacy 5% lanthanum product; however, commercialisation is unproven, dependent on 2026-2027 field trial outcomes (US, China), and management explicitly flags no assurance of success, making this a speculative optionality catalyst rather than a de-risked compounder thesis.
